data.reason: The record contains 10 accepted formal-artifact positions in unresolved rivalry (per PRC_11) with no source evidence to resolve whether RFC idempotence is sufficient or insufficient for the log's ordering and causality constraints.
data.requirement: A determination of whether the append-only event log's required property is RFC 9110 idempotence simpliciter or a stronger log-specific property (deterministic-replay idempotence, operational deduplication, or write-ordered idempotence) requires comparison of verbatim RFC definitions against the operational requirements of append-only logs under at-least-once delivery.
